lighting_shading.note: Soft, diffused lighting creates a friendly, toy-like atmosphere.

value_contrast.note: Strong value separation between the orange locker and purple wall.

color_palette.note: Vibrant orange and purple complementary scheme is very eye-catching.

composition_hierarchy.note: Central composition with a clear, singular focal point.

shape_proportions.note: Rounded corners and thick forms give it a stylized feel.

viewpoint_depth.note: Standard three-quarter view provides good spatial understanding.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by lighting rather than line art.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, matte plastic look typical of modern mobile games.

pose_rhythm.note: Repetitive vent slats create a rhythmic vertical pattern.
